comment: The coefficient jacks get no family: a coefficient is neither audio nor a control voltage, and what is patched between an out and its in can be anything. Patching a coefficient output straight back into its input changes nothing, to float precision, which is what makes the pair an insert. Slider gains are applied before the substitution, so a coefficient driven from outside is not multiplied by its slider. The zero buttons always land on zero from any partial position, so a button is one press from silence whatever the slider was doing, and each one touches only its own column. The panel prints quadrare, the numbers 0 to 15 over the columns, coeff out, zero, coeff in, in, size, keep, quant, level, dry/wet, above, comp, res and out.
